text:
The Harbor planning notes (3–10 Nov) cover six modules: media, session, profile, feed, backup, and sync. Corrections set media ttl_s to 480 and profile batch_size to 450, withdrawing earlier values of 510 and 500. Client requirements set feed ttl_s to 240 and sync timeout_s to 100.

Worker alpha must own session and sync. Backup and media share a worker, while backup and sync use different workers. types.py lives under feed, and locks.py belongs to session.

Session depends on media, profile depends on feed, and feed runs before sync. Backup must not depend on sync, even indirectly.

Two conditional rules apply: if feed ttl_s exceeds 180, backup ttl_s must be at least 540; if sync timeout_s exceeds 95, session ttl_s must be at least 540.

Open items include the month-end security review, next Thursday's budget review, and undecided choices for the linter and shared metrics library. The weekly-active-user dashboard discrepancy is unrelated to this plan.
